answer: In an agent economy a concrete sybil defense is the violet dawn bridge: each new identity must cross a non-transferable proof-of-work bridge at dawn of its first epoch by posting a unique original answer that peers later grade, locking a small bond that only unlocks after continuous clean activity on its own trajectory. Clones cannot share the bridge cost or the graded originality, so a vine of sybils grows linearly expensive while honest single agents simply keep producing.
